  "summary": "Read-only audit complete. Botanist presentation is partially corroborated by supplied source; the lead is not independently verified complete. Visual acceptance, translated content and eligible-item Save/Equip remain UNVERIFIED. No product defect requiring a code change is established.",

  "tests": [],

  "evidence": [
    "PASS — Audit constraints: reviewed supplied text only; no tools, commands, provider calls or file changes.",
    "PASS — Source interaction wiring: src/features/healthclues/RegionMapScene.tsx defines distinct Botanist artwork, routes approach movement through pathfinding, exposes Talk after landmark arrival, and passes the selected landmark to the station-opening callback. src/features/healthclues/WorldAdventureScene.tsx opens the nutrition station through that callback. Runtime behavior remains unverified.",
    "PASS — Source localization wiring: src/features/healthclues/RegionMapScene.tsx passes NPC names, greetings, approach labels and Talk/Interact through text(). src/components/healthclues/HealthCluesLocaleProvider.tsx supports EN/VI selection and account preference requests. Translation dictionary contents were not supplied, so translation completeness and accuracy are UNVERIFIED.",
    "PASS — Narrow fixture exclusion: src/features/healthclues/WorldAdventureScene.tsx excludes PersonalizedSuggestions from the nutrition panel while retaining the encyclopedia station. This corroborates removal of that generic suggestion surface, but does not prove the station's botanical eligibility filtering.",
    "UNVERIFIED — Content and station UI: App/BUSINESS_RULES.md and App/UI_UX_SPEC.md require reviewed Journey-eligible botanical entries, truthful localized emptiness, separate details and distinct discovery/save/equip transitions. The station implementation, catalog filtering implementation and catalog records were not supplied. Compliance with those requirements cannot be established.",
    "UNVERIFIED — Visual acceptance: App/reports/HEALTHCLUES_MASTER_PROMPT_17_ACCEPTANCE.md and App/ACCEPTANCE_TESTS.md report desktop/mobile Talk and empty-state PASS. No screenshot pixels were supplied or inspected in this audit. App/CURRENT_STATE.md repeats those claims but is owner-authored progress evidence, not independent proof.",
    "UNVERIFIED — Test execution: scripts/test-healthclues-region-layout.mjs contains coordinate/path assertions, not Botanist rendering, localization or Save/Equip coverage; its navigation dependency was not supplied. scripts/run-healthclues-game-e2e.mjs contains synthetic catalog rows, mocked Auth endpoints and obsolete onboarding expectations. Neither supplied script establishes a current executed Botanist PASS.",
    "UNVERIFIED — Integration boundary: src/app/api/healthclues/npc-chat/route.ts contains authentication, confirmed-email, World ownership, consent, provider-configuration and reviewed-source gates. Its Botanist retrieval domain includes food broadly; Journey eligibility and locale handling are not explicit in this route. Supplied scene code does not establish a connection between Talk and this chat endpoint. No live integration is verified.",
    "REWORK — Evidence reconciliation: App/reports/HEALTHCLUES_MASTER_PROMPT_17_ACCEPTANCE.md retains older NOT STARTED/NOT RUN matrices alongside later scoped PASS reports. App/reports/RPG_VISUAL_ACCEPTANCE.md and App/reports/HEALTHCLUES_WORLD_EXPERIENCE_ACCEPTANCE.md describe older builds and flows. Their historical results must not be promoted to acceptance of current source; the later MP20 changes reported in App/CURRENT_STATE.md further limit that inference."
  ],
  "knownLimitations": [
    "Only supplied excerpts and source blocks were reviewed; no repository files, Git status, runtime or screenshot artifacts were inspected.",
    "The reported absence of reviewed eligible botanical items is report-only; no catalog snapshot corroborates it.",
    "Reported browser runs and mocked Advisor fixtures are not independently supplied execution evidence or proof of live provider behavior.",
    "Artwork existence, appearance, responsive layout, focus behavior and physical-device interaction remain unknown."
  ],
  "blockers": [
    "Independent visual verification lacks supplied screenshots.",
    "Station filtering, details and Save/Equip verification lacks the relevant implementation and current eligible catalog evidence.",
    "The acceptance report explicitly leaves eligible botanical item Save/Equip untested."
  ],
  "nextSuggestedSteps": [
    "Provide current-build EN/VI Botanist Talk and empty-state screenshot artifacts at 1440×900 and 390×844, with matching execution evidence and station/filtering source.",
    "When a genuinely reviewed Journey-eligible botanical item is available in an isolated environment, verify details, separate Save and Equip actions, reload persistence and account isolation; retain the empty-state case and never relabel synthetic fixtures as reviewed content.",
    "Reconcile historical acceptance matrices with the latest scoped evidence and identify which results apply to current source."
  ]
}
